axis-marcus.text: Yo did you see the new DeepSeek update?
Yeah running it locally now. Insane.

axis-ava.text: Sending you the design files tonight
Perfect, I'll review first thing tomorrow
also love the new Studio layout btw

axis-jordan.text: That system you built is wild
Still a lot to wire up but getting there

axis-priya.text: Can we jump on a call later?
have some ideas for the data pipeline

axis-dex.text: You using Ollama for local inference?
Yeah gemma3 mostly. Decent for quick stuff

axis-nadia.text: Did you end up going with the agent architecture?
Yep. Four sub-brains running in parallel now

axis-sam.text: Almost. OAuth is being a pain

axis-riley.text: Okay I finally set up SOMA on my end
haha thanks, still a lot of rough edges

axis-layla.text: I wrote up some notes on the memory system if you want them

axis-cole.text: working on something kinda related to what you're building
can I show you next week?

axis-eva.text: Hey long time, how are you?

axis-ben.text: The social posting feature is live?
Just launched it, Bluesky integration is working

axis-mia.text: Got your message, will respond properly tonight
No rush, just wanted to flag it

axis-kai.text: Running 4 agents in parallel sounds expensive

axis-jade.text: I saw the photos, looks incredible

axis-aaron.text: quick question about your goal engine
is it fully autonomous or does it need prompting?
Both modes, I can show you

axis-luna.text: Did you see that paper on constitutional AI?
yes! loved the section on value alignment
exactly what I'm trying to build into SOMA
